touches.subject: CFO Stack
touches.body:
Hi Aditya,

Saw the CFO Stack launch. Virtual Accounts that confirm corporate transfers in real time, right next to card and PayNow payments, is a smart way to take manual matching off SME finance teams, and supplier payments and payroll will widen that surface a lot.

My guess is the hard part isn't the happy path but the leftovers: the transfer that doesn't match an invoice, the partial payment, the payout that bounces, each needing someone to own it.

We have the base in place: one case per transaction with its full trail, flags when something drifts, and a suggested next step. The interesting part is what to build on top, and we want to shape it with a few payments teams on their real data rather than guess.

For HitPay, that could mean an exceptions layer inside CFO Stack, under your brand, tested first on a month of your Virtual Account transfers. From an export, no integration needed.

Worth testing on unmatched transfers, or is another part of the CFO Stack roadmap a better fit?

Ilia Frolov
CRO & Product Architect, HAIA
haia.finance
Aditya, saw the CFO Stack launch. I emailed you an idea for the unmatched-transfer side of Virtual Accounts. Would value your view.

Hi Aditya,

Another angle, on your side rather than your merchants': you've been hiring for payment operations and finance roles this year, with reconciliation across entities and payment flows in the scope.

The same approach works there as a shadow replay: last month's settlements from an export, which cases stalled, why, and what would have closed them sooner.

Is internal reconciliation a bigger drag than the merchant side right now?

Ilia

Aditya, last note from me. If payment operations sit with someone else day to day, who would be best to ask? Happy to take it from there.

Ilia
